test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in passive voice.

The audience loudly cheered the student leader’s speech.

options.text: The student leader’s speech was loudly cheered by the audience.
There was a loud cheer for the student.
They all cheered loudly the leader’s speech.
The student leader was loudly cheered by the audience.

solution:
The correct answer is: **'The student leader’s speech was loudly cheered by the audience'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer of the active to passive is: **'The student leader’s speech was loudly cheered by the audience'.**
 
• The given sentence is in **'Past Indefinite Tense'**. The structure of it is: **'Subject + v2 (Second form of the verb) + Object'.**
 
• While changing it active to passive,** 'the subject'** (**The audience**) will be '**Object'** and the '**Object'** (**T****he student leader’s speech**) will be the '**subject'** and '**verb'** will be placed according to '**the** **Subject'** **(If it is singular, singular verb will be used. If it is plural, plural verb will be used**).
 
• Here, the subject in the passive voice (**T****he student leader’s speech**) is **singular**, So, **singular verb** (**was**) is used. Then, '**Past Participle form of the verb'** (**cheered**) is used. Next, **'by**' is used according to the rule. Thereafter, **the object** (**the audience**) is used.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'There was a loud cheer for the student' **is not the correct passive voice.
 
• **'They all cheered loudly the leader’s speech'** is not the correct passive voice.
 
• **'The student leader was loudly cheered by the audience'** is not the correct passive voice.
